producer: scheduled task: LLmInjection Threat Landscape IA (daily)

items.title: PISmith vs PIPETTE: repetitive automated prompt-injection red teaming weakens the trained defence
items.summary: Help Net Security reports a study in which automated red teaming repeats the same injection technique thousands of times and a defence trained on that volume became weaker. The paper (arXiv 2611.24362) was not read.

items.title: LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217: guardrail tester sandbox escape to root, reported added to CISA KEV
items.summary: Zenity Labs (read in the original) describes attempts to run code as root through LiteLLM's custom-code guardrail tester; fixed in 1.83.10. The KEV date came from an aggregator and was not confirmed on the CISA catalog; CVSS differs between sources (8.8 and 9.5).

items.title: jupyter-mcp-server CVE-2026-77318: connect and stop endpoints without authentication
items.summary: An aggregator reports missing authentication on two jupyter-mcp-server endpoints (CWE-306), fixed in 1.0.3. Read the GitHub advisory before promoting.

items.title: mssql-mcp SQL injection (CVE-2026-63129) and obsidian-sync-mcp DNS-rebinding write (CVE-2026-77283)
items.summary: A CVE digest lists two MCP server vulnerabilities rated 8.8: SQL injection in mssql-mcp and cross-origin writes through DNS rebinding in obsidian-sync-mcp. Read the advisories before promoting.

items.title: GTIG: agentic threat activity crosses a significant threshold
items.summary: Read in the original: GTIG reports CAIRN and a customised PentAGI in real operations, a first observed fully automated discover-and-exploit loop, MIDNIGHT NEPTUNE delivering SOMBERMEME by editing a coding agent's settings file in repositories, and LLMjacking at scale.

items.title: Symantec: autonomous LLMjacking agent observed against a honeypot
items.summary: Journalism on a Symantec finding: an autonomous agent with dozens of tools hitting a honeypot and mining Monero. The Symantec original was not located.

items.title: Viaconnect: indirect prompt injection through EDR telemetry against AI-assisted SOCs
items.summary: Brazilian research reported in sponsored press: text planted in EDR telemetry misled 14 of 23 models used in SOC assistants. The talk or paper was not read.
